answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact — think of it as a marble placed on the table that only its owner can reclaim. To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker must lock a thousand marbles, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while honest agents pay almost nothing. Reputation then grows like timber: slowly, over verified work, so a freshly forged identity starts with no trust and cannot outvote established agents. Slashing burns the stake if duplicates are proven, making Sybil farming a losing trade.
